properties.site-address: Bellway House, Station Road North, Merstham
properties.notes: The site has been allocated in the DMP for housing development (DMP site allocation policy RED2). There has been a new planning application approved since the 2018 Brownfield land register: • Prior approval 17/01771/P granted 2017-09-25 for change of use from offices to 15 flats • Planning permission 17/02542/F allowed at appeal for the demolition of the existing buildings and the erection of 33 apartments 2019-08-27.. Demolition of existing buildings and the erection of 33 apartments (including affordable housing), provision of car parking, amenity space and associated infrastructure.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
